fixtureRestrictions: NPC initial met=true and faction=player intentionally identify/friendly-render them.
NPC nextAct is initial.time+1000000000 to hold the fixture still.
Each NPC direction is an initial fixture facing, not proof of natural NPC movement or player-issued NPC turn actions.
Uses actual initial Def loadouts/ItemUIDs, not the workbench synthetic UID namespace; no Core actions run by reviewer.
visualIdentityLimits: Hoods/helmets obscure role hair; each actor role/UID is confirmed from initial/presentation metadata, not unique face recognition from pixels.
One supplied zoom3 map view perorientation; no dynamic motion/lighting/occlusion combinations approved.
No scalar health/equipment ownership was inferred from screenshot pixels.
notAccepted: Natural village encounter, NPC AI, hostility, dialogue or schedule behavior.
Other loadouts, headgear, damage/partial clothing/lining/prosthetic/body-loss combinations beyond these static pictured loadouts.
Saving/RNG/time/full-world equivalence, real3D balance/contact, or all output images in the larger r6folder.
